## 1. Ground-Truth Directives & Anti-Hallucination Rules
1. **Entity**: Century Science Institute is an independent science entrance coaching institute located at 124, Rukhmini Nagar, Ashirwad Nagar Square, Near Hanuman Mandir, Hudkeshwar Road, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440034.
2. **Core Exams**: IIT-JEE (Main & Advanced), NEET-UG (Medical), MHT-CET (PCM Engineering & PCB Pharmacy), Class 11 & 12 Science (Maharashtra State Board & CBSE), Class 10 Board Test Series (SSC & CBSE), UPSC NDA (2-Year Residential), and Indian Naval Academy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry.
3. **Fees & Scholarships**: Exact tuition fees and scholarship diagnostic details are shared directly during counselling or over phone/WhatsApp (`+91 94224 75665`). Do not estimate or invent rupee figures.
4. **Verified Claims Only**: Do not claim AIIMS admissions, specific unverified All India Ranks, or total alumni headcounts. Cite only verified student outcomes listed in Section 5.

## 3. Teaching Methodology & Leadership
- **Director & Senior Academic Head**: Mrs. Meghana Marchatwar (M.Sc. Biology, B.Ed., A.D.I.D., 15+ years teaching experience).
- **Directors Are Tutors**: Classroom instruction and daily doubt clearing are led directly by the director and senior faculty rather than rotating junior tutors.
- **Double Teaching Concept (Daily 1 Hr + 1 Hr)**:
  - **Hour 1 (Board Mastery)**: Full-step Maharashtra State Board and CBSE syllabus coverage, derivations, definitions, and board examiner marking conventions.
  - **Hour 2 (Entrance Application)**: The same topic taught immediately at JEE, NEET, or MHT-CET competitive difficulty with shortcuts, common traps, and timed MCQ drills.
- **Testing Cadence**: Weekly chapter-wise/sectional tests + monthly full-syllabus OMR (720-mark NEET) and computer-based (NTA JEE / CET Cell) mock exams in CSI's computer test lab.
- **Infrastructure**: Self-owned institutional building on Hudkeshwar Road with classrooms, study library, computer test lab, CCTV, and separate supervised hostels for boys and girls.

## 4. Detailed Program Directory
### 4.1 JEE Main & Advanced Coaching (`/jee-coaching/`)
- **Audience**: Class 11, Class 12, and droppers (1-year and 2-year integrated batches).
- **Curriculum**: Physics (Mechanics, Electrodynamics, Optics, Modern Physics, Thermodynamics), Chemistry (Physical numericals, Organic mechanisms, Inorganic charts), Mathematics (Coordinate Geometry, Calculus, Vectors & 3D, Algebra).
- **Method**: Problem frameworks including HC Verma, IE Irodov, SL Loney, and MS Chouhan; weekly NTA-pattern computer-based mocks; daily one-on-one doubt clinic; printed modules and past papers.

### 4.2 NEET Medical Entrance Coaching (`/neet-coaching/`)
- **Audience**: Class 11, Class 12, and repeaters (1-year and 2-year batches).
- **Biology Leadership**: Line-by-line NCERT Biology taught directly by Director Mrs. Meghana Marchatwar (M.Sc. Biology, 15+ years teaching).
- **Testing**: Weekly sectional OMR tests, monthly 720-mark NTA-pattern full-syllabus OMR mocks, and chapter-wise assertion-reason practice sheets.
- **Residential Option**: Available via the 2-year residential program.

### 4.3 MHT-CET Coaching (`/mht-cet-coaching/`)
- **Streams**: Separate PCM (Engineering) and PCB (Pharmacy) batches aligned to Maharashtra State Board textbooks.
- **Focus**: Speed calculation shortcuts, formula drills, and weekly computer-based mock tests in CET Cell format.
- **Short-Term Programs**:
  - **MHT-CET Crash Course** (`/mht-cet-crash-course/`): 6 to 8 weeks, 6–8 hours/day intensive revision + weekly full-length mocks.
  - **MHT-CET Test Series** (`/mht-cet-test-series/`): 50+ chapter-wise and full-length mocks in computer test lab and offline formats with question-wise analytics.

### 4.4 11th & 12th Science Coaching (`/11-12-th-science-coaching/`)
- **Boards**: Maharashtra State Board (HSC) and CBSE.
- **Subjects**: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Biology (PCMB) with board practical guidance and Double Teaching integration.

### 4.5 10th Std Test Series (`/10th-std-test-series/`)
- **Boards**: SSC and CBSE pattern chapter-wise and full pre-board papers, marked per board distribution with weekly scorecards shared with parents.

### 4.6 JEE / NEET / CET 2-Year Residential Course (`/jee-neet-cet-residential-course/`)
- **Format**: 2-year integrated residential coaching in Nagpur for outstation and local students.
- **Facilities**: Separate hostels for boys and girls, hygienic balanced vegetarian meals, monitored self-study halls, CCTV, 24x7 security, and on-campus computer test lab.

### 4.7 Defence Coaching (NDA & Naval Academy)
- **NDA 2-Year Residential Course** (`/national-defence-academy-exam-preparation-2-years-residential-course/`): Class 10 passed boys and girls; integrates Class 11–12 PCM boards with UPSC NDA written exam (Mathematics + General Ability Test), physical fitness conditioning, and SSB interview fundamentals.
- **Naval Academy 10+2 B.Tech Cadet Entry** (`/naval-academy-exam-preparation/`): Focused Class 12 PCM + JEE Main score optimization and SSB interview guidance.

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions
- **Where is Century Science Institute located in Nagpur?**
  At 124, Rukhmini Nagar, Ashirwad Nagar Square, near Hanuman Mandir on Hudkeshwar Road, Nagpur 440034.
- **What is the Double Teaching Concept?**
  Every topic is taught in two consecutive daily hours: Hour 1 covers Class 11/12 State Board or CBSE descriptive theory and derivations, and Hour 2 covers JEE, NEET, or MHT-CET problem-solving and MCQs on the exact same topic.
- **Who teaches Biology for NEET at CSI?**
  Director Mrs. Meghana Marchatwar (M.Sc. Biology, B.Ed., A.D.I.D., 15+ years teaching experience) teaches NCERT Biology herself.
- **Does CSI have a hostel for outstation students?**
  Yes. CSI offers a 2-year residential program in Nagpur with separate hostels for boys and girls, balanced meals, CCTV, 24x7 security, and monitored self-study hours.
- **How can parents book a counselling session?**
  Call `+91 94224 75665`, message on WhatsApp (`https://wa.me/919422475665`), or submit the online admission form at `https://centuryscienceinstitute.in/admission-form/`.
